title: This Country Deleted an Entire Day 🤯 #shorts
desc:
On December 29, 2011, Samoa went to sleep on a Thursday and woke up on Saturday. Friday, December 30, 2011 never happened there. Samoa moved to the other side of the International Date Line to line up with its main trading partners, Australia and New Zealand, and workers scheduled for the missing Friday were still paid.

Sources: BBC News, Time and Date, CBS News.

title: The Closest Humans Here Are in Space 🚀 #shorts
desc:
Point Nemo is the spot in the ocean farthest from any land, about 2,688 km from the nearest (uninhabited) land. The International Space Station orbits roughly 400 km up, so when it passes overhead, astronauts are the nearest humans. It's also where old satellites and space stations are brought down: a spacecraft graveyard.

Sources: NOAA National Ocean Service, BBC Sky at Night.
